_meta.ilvl_rule: shop ilvl = clvl + 5, capped at 99 (purediablo 2023-02-22; Hastmannen ~2021). Brackets: clvl 20 -> ilvl 25 (magic-only from here); 55 -> 60; 70 -> 75; 75 -> 80; 94 -> 99.
_meta.dating_note: diablo2.io prints '(pre-Resurrected)' after EVERY post age, including 2026 posts (e.g. the 3.1.2 patch thread '5 months ago (pre-Resurrected)'); it is not a date marker. Posts are dated here from the 'N years/months ago' text relative to 2026-09-18.

AN-claw-traps.difficulty: Hell (Nightmare also stocks claws, but no elite upgrade and lower exceptional chance)
AN-claw-traps.item: Greater Talons / Runic Talons (also Greater Claws / Feral Claws) - magic (blue), exceptional or elite only
AN-claw-traps.affixes: Prefix Cunning (+3 Traps) or Witch-hunter's (+2 Assassin Skills); suffix of Quickness (+40 IAS) / of Swiftness (+30); staff mods +3 Lightning Sentry (best), +3 Death Sentry, +3 Wake of Fire, Fade/BoS/Weapon Block/Mind Blast as bonus. Targets named by sources: 'Cunning Greater Talons of Quickness' (+6 LS = +3 tree +3 staffmod), 'Witch-hunter's Greater Talons' (+5 LS). Then 2 sockets from Larzuk.
AN-claw-traps.clvl: 75 minimum (ilvl 80 is what BMAY gives for the +3 skill-tree affix); 94+ recommended (ilvl 99 = max exceptional/elite chance). Derived: Runic Talons have qlvl 81 (purediablo table) and an item type only appears when qlvl <= ilvl (Hastmannen), so Runic bases need clvl >= 76.
AN-claw-traps.ilvl: shop ilvl = clvl + 5, capped at 99 (purediablo 2023-02-22; Hastmannen ~2021). Brackets: clvl 20 -> ilvl 25 (magic-only from here); 55 -> 60; 70 -> 75; 75 -> 80; 94 -> 99.
AN-claw-traps.odds: Per BMAY (pre-RotW, harrogath affix calc): claw rolls exceptional 15.24% / elite 2.28% at ilvl 80 (combined 16.82%); 17.67% / 2.58% at ilvl 99 (19.34%). Staff mods only on exceptional/elite claws. Per claw at clvl 94+: +5 or +6 LS 1:41,118; +6 LS 1:328,947; +5/+6 Venom 1:102,833; +6 Venom 1:826,446. Anya averaged 3.5 claws per refresh over 500 refreshes (1,756 claws). Expected: a +5 LS claw every ~10 h, +6 LS ~78 h at ~4,200 claws/h - per source, verify.
source: diablo2.io forum t8592 'Claw Shopping Guide by BMAY' ('5 years ago', pre-RotW; fetched 2026-09-18; pricing/raw/d2io/claw-guide-bmay.html)

AN-claw-traps.value: WP-B. Orientation only: d2runes 'Costs 10-20 x Jah' (undated); maxroll VMI 'Very High' (2024); diablo2.io 2026-08-28 guide has no claw row (only 'Assassin Traps' skiller Pul-Um).
AN-claw-traps.notes: Demand RotW-era: S-tier Lightning Sentry Assassin and A-tier Wake of Fire Assassin guides (May 22, 2026) list 'Cunning Greater Talons of Quickness' as top weapon/off-hand ('Greater Talons and Greater Claws are the best bases due to their low requirements'). Anya sells only two claw classes: Blade/Greater/Runic Talons and Scissors Katar/Quhab/Suwayyah (purediablo). BMAY trick: keep dexterity at exactly 55 (Scissors Katar req) so every exceptional/elite claw shows red and only red claws need a mouse-over; beware -requirements suffixes (Greater Talons 79 dex -> 56 with Simplicity).

AN-armor-whale.item: Body armor, magic: 'Jeweler's <armor> of the Whale' - Jeweler's = 4 sockets, of the Whale = +100 life (alvl 55 per d2io comment). Archon Plate roll is the valuable one; at ilvl 75 the base is Ancient Armor with a 2.2% elite upgrade to Archon Plate (d2io Anya-page comment).
AN-armor-whale.affixes: Jeweler's (Socketed 4) + of the Whale (+100 Life; maxroll VMI counts 80-100 life). Sister targets from the same comment: Jeweler's ... of Amicae (15 PDR), Jeweler's ... of Stability (24 FHR).
AN-armor-whale.clvl: 70 (-> ilvl 75) per d2runes and the d2io Anya comment; d2runes lists the row as 'Anya (Hell) Clvl: 70'.
AN-armor-whale.ilvl: shop ilvl = clvl + 5, capped at 99 (purediablo 2023-02-22; Hastmannen ~2021). Brackets: clvl 20 -> ilvl 25 (magic-only from here); 55 -> 60; 70 -> 75; 75 -> 80; 94 -> 99.
AN-armor-whale.odds: Per d2io Anya-page comment ('4 years ago', pre-RotW): 4sox+100life 1/473,600 per armor (1/441,600 with alvl 55-59); 4sox+15pdr 1/142,080; 4sox+24fhr 1/17,760. Larzuk/Halbu (Hell) are slower to re-roll but show more armors per window (same comment).

AN-mechanics.item: Shop mechanics that gate every row above.
AN-mechanics.ilvl: shop ilvl = clvl + 5, capped at 99 (purediablo 2023-02-22; Hastmannen ~2021). Brackets: clvl 20 -> ilvl 25 (magic-only from here); 55 -> 60; 70 -> 75; 75 -> 80; 94 -> 99.
AN-mechanics.odds: Upgrade formulas (purediablo/BMAY): Exceptional in Nightmare ((ilvl*64)+4000)/100,000; Exceptional in Hell ((ilvl*128)+5000)/100,000; Elite in Hell ((ilvl*16)+1000)/100,000; upgrades need ilvl 25+. Affix level (purediablo; maxroll staff-mods Feb 10, 2026): if ilvl < 99 - qlvl/2 then alvl = ilvl - qlvl/2 else alvl = 2*ilvl - 99 (integers). Example: Greater Talons qlvl 50 at clvl 75 -> ilvl 80 -> alvl 55; Runic Talons qlvl 81 at ilvl 80 -> alvl 61; at ilvl 99 -> 99.

AN-mechanics.notes: Never ethereal from shops (Hastmannen). Magic only from ilvl 25 (both). Elite bases only in Hell and only from A3 Hell on; A1/A2 Hell never elite; items tagged 'hell upgrade' never roll exceptional/elite (Hastmannen). Item type appears only when qlvl <= ilvl (Hastmannen). Staff mods only on exceptional/elite claws (BMAY, purediablo). Staff-mod tier base by ilvl: 1-11 t1, 12-18 t2, 19-24 t3, 25-36 t4, 37+ t5; 20% +1 / 50% same / 20% -1 / 10% -2; +3 if RND[100] >= 90; 3 skills if >= 91 (purediablo). Shop window does not refresh while another player is in town (Hastmannen). Gold: purediablo 'load up with gold, at least 1,000,000'; d2runes ~50,000 per gambled ring; a Hastmannen-thread reply ('1 year ago') says vendor orbs 'regularly go for >300k'.

AN-refresh-loop.notes: As the sources state it: (1) Anya and the Red Portal are SW of the Harrogath waypoint; the portal exists once 'Prison of Ice' (rescue Anya) is done (maxroll Pindle guide). (2) Click Trade, check the weapons tab for claws / armor tab for gloves and armor (purediablo). (3) Nothing good -> 'go to the red portal and go through and quickly back again. If you are quick you won't wake up any of the zombies. This refreshes what she has to sell. Rinse & repeat' (purediablo); BMAY: 'Keep Nihlathak's portal open and run between it and Anya'. (4) maxroll tips: the Red Portal 'no longer disappears in Diablo 2 Resurrected. Use Nihlathak's Temple Red Portal next to Anya to reset the shops in Harrogath quickly'. (5) Caveat: no refresh while another player is in town (Hastmannen). Synthesis (ours, not a source): every Pindleskin run already passes through this portal, so check Anya once per run and use pure portal-hopping only when shopping is the goal.
